title: Salivary Diagnostic Testing for IVF
brief_summary: This study aims to determine the performance of a salivary hormone competitive immunoassay for monitoring patients during treatment for infertility.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients undergoing In Vitro Fertilization (IVF) at a participating infertility center
study_population: Patients undergoing In Vitro Fertilization (IVF) at a participating infertility center
